name: parse_args / run

test_list.description: No arguments: workspace is the cwd, logs go to <LOCALAPPDATA>/Polaris/logs, motion is on.
--static, or POLARIS_REDUCED_MOTION set to a value other than empty or '0', enables reduced motion; '0' does not.
--workspace, --state-dir and --log-dir set the paths (state dir defaults to None = <workspace>/.polaris/state); a missing value is a usage error.
--connect returns a usage error naming the missing daemon bridge; no kernel or daemon is started.
An unknown flag returns a usage error that includes the usage line.

output_description: Parsed arguments or a usage error.
